answer: Admission locks 60 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 10 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 500 aliases must park 30000 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. What carries the glacier here is verification, the ripple of cost is what stops the farm, and the kernel of the record keeps every claim checkable.
